name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, with an apprenticeship at a small accounting firm servicing local racing teams. It was there she discovered her knack for navigating the complex financial landscapes of racing. Before joining Sodi Kart Factory, she honed her skills managing budgets for a regional rally team and then moved to a formula racing support team, gaining experience in forecasting and cost control. 

Klara approaches her role with a meticulous eye for detail and a commitment to financial stability, ensuring the team operates within budget while maximizing performance. She excels at identifying cost-saving opportunities and developing innovative financial strategies, always looking for ways to give Sodi Kart a competitive edge. She also enjoys mentoring junior staff, helping them to learn the unique challenges of motorsports finance.

What sets Klara apart is her unwavering dedication to accuracy and her ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for the team. Her methodical approach and calm demeanor under pressure make her a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of kart racing.
